hero.title: Your website, built and looked after. One simple monthly price.
hero.lede: We build your site, host it, keep it healthy on Google and make your changes. Human run, AI powered.

included.t: A site built for your business
included.d: Up to 5 pages, designed for phones first, written with you. Not a template you fill in yourself.
Fast pages on Cloudflare's global network, with the padlock (SSL) on. Every version is saved, so any change can be undone.
Page titles, descriptions, a sitemap and Google Search Console set up, then checked every month.
Email us what you want changed: new text, a photo, a price, a new section. Each round is up to 30 minutes of work. We do it, you check it.
Visits, Google searches and enquiries in plain English, so you can see what the site is doing for you.
You email a person, not a ticket system. We reply within two business days, usually sooner.

steps.d: Two minutes on the form. If you already have a site, send us the link.
We write and design it, then send you a private link to check on your phone. Change what you like before it goes live.

steps.t: Go live, then we look after it
steps.d: We connect your domain, set up Google and keep everything running. You email us when you want a change.

ai.title: Human run, AI powered
paragraphs: We use AI to do the heavy lifting: drafting pages, checking speed and Google basics, and making changes quickly. That's how we include the build and your changes in one fair monthly price.
A person runs every job. Simon plans your site with you, checks every page before it goes live and answers your emails himself. Nothing goes live without a human signing it off.

change: A change round is a small update to your site, up to 30 minutes of work: new or edited text, swapping photos, updating prices or opening hours, or adding a section to an existing page. Send your edits together in one email. Unused rounds don't carry over. A brand-new page or a redesign is quoted first.

faq.a: $99 + GST a month ($108.90 inc GST), charged by card each month. That covers hosting, security, Google upkeep, your dashboard and 2 change rounds a month.
Setup is $499 + GST, once. Founding client offer: our first 10 clients pay no setup fee when they sign up for 12 months and are happy for us to share a short testimonial.

A small update, up to 30 minutes of work: new or edited text, swapping photos, updating prices or opening hours, or a new section on an existing page. Send your edits together in one email. Extra rounds are $50 + GST. A brand-new page or a redesign is quoted first.
Standard plans are month to month: cancel before your next month starts. The founding offer is a 12-month plan, because we waive the setup fee. Full details are in our terms.
You own your domain name and your content. If you leave, we send you your site files and help you move your domain.

faq.q: Do I need a domain name?
faq.a: Yes, your own address like yourbusiness.com.au. Domains are bought in your business's name, usually about $20 to $30 a year from the registrar. We'll help you buy it, or connect the one you have.

faq.q: Do you use AI to build sites?
faq.a: Yes, for the heavy lifting. A person plans your site with you, checks every page before it goes live and answers your emails.
Your first monthly payment is taken when your site goes live. You'll see and approve a private preview first.
Melbourne. We work with businesses anywhere in Australia, by email, phone or video call.
